note: News sweep: prosecutors' action on complaints against the criminal police chief; Senjak case suspicions.

event.label: reported
event.text: Serbia's Supreme Public Prosecutor's Office orders the Belgrade prosecutors to act on student complaints against criminal police chief Marko Kričak over an August 2025 incident in a Government of Serbia garage, which had gone more than a year without result, Vreme reports. The paper says Kričak, detained on November 1, was still in custody on November 3.

event.label: reported
event.text: Belgrade's chief prosecutor says there is a well-founded suspicion that Kričak and another senior police officer abused their positions in a May 2026 murder investigation, and grounds to suspect Kričak abused a person on police premises, BBC News in Serbian reports.

ops.text: Whether Kričak's 48-hour detention was extended or he was charged: not clear in the reports found as of November 4
